search_scope: Targeted primary-source web/arXiv search; not a database-complete absence proof.
exact_combination_description: Finite Xene Corbino annulus + smooth finite-time AB flux protocol + reservoir bias/coupling + two-time interacting Keldysh/EOM + persistent/reservoir separation + inner/outer/bulk decomposition + Rashba spin torque.

sources.title: Equilibrium currents in a Corbino graphene ring
sources.scope: Tight-binding graphene Corbino with kinetic and Rashba spin-orbit coupling; persistent equilibrium currents.
sources.implication: Stationary Corbino/Rashba persistent-current block is prior art.

sources.title: Persistent charge and spin currents in the long wavelength regime for graphene rings
sources.scope: Graphene Corbino/ring Hamiltonian with intrinsic and Rashba spin-orbit coupling and persistent charge/spin currents.
sources.implication: Persistent charge/spin observables with ISO/Rashba are not new by themselves.

sources.title: Topological spin and valley pumping in silicene
sources.scope: Time-dependent electric fields drive spin- and valley-dependent pumping in silicene.
sources.implication: Dynamic spin/valley response in silicene exists, although it is not the same reservoir-coupled Corbino protocol.

sources.title: Real-time dynamics of spin-dependent transport through a double-quantum-dot Aharonov-Bohm interferometer with spin-orbit interaction
sources.scope: Real-time spin-dependent currents, AB flux, spin-orbit phase and explicit connection to Keldysh Green functions in a double-dot interferometer.
sources.implication: Transient AB plus SOI spin currents are prior art in a different geometry.

sources.title: Time-dependent transport in Aharonov-Bohm interferometers
sources.scope: Time-dependent dynamics and AB oscillations in realistic quantum-Hall interferometers.
sources.implication: AB transients and flux-dependent interference are not methodologically new.

sources.title: Time-dependent wave packet simulations of transport through Aharonov-Bohm rings with an embedded quantum dot
sources.scope: Time-dependent wave-packet transport through an AB ring with an embedded dot.
sources.implication: Finite-time AB-ring dynamics predate the present project, even without Xene topology.

sources.title: Time-resolved impurity-invisibility in graphene nanoribbons
sources.scope: Time-resolved charge transport and local current pathways in graphene nanoribbons after bias quenches.
sources.implication: Transient graphene transport and local pathway rearrangement are prior art; geometry and observables differ.

sources.title: All-electrical generation of spin-polarized currents in quantum spin Hall insulators
sources.scope: Transient and ac spin-polarized currents in a stanene QSH nanoribbon, with relevance to silicene and germanene.
sources.implication: Transient spin-polarized transport in Xene-like QSH systems is not unprecedented.

sources.title: Electron interferometry and quantum spin Hall phase in silicene
sources.scope: Silicene quantum-ring/two-path interference and distinction between normal and QSH transport.
sources.implication: Silicene ring geometry and QSH/bulk-edge interference have direct stationary precedent.

sources.title: Kadanoff–Baym approach to quantum transport through interacting nanoscale systems
sources.scope: Interacting two-time Kadanoff–Baym transport, embedding and conserving approximations.
sources.implication: Broad two-time KBE/EOM method novelty is prior art.

sources.title: A nonequilibrium theory for transient transport dynamics in nanostructures via the Feynman-Vernon influence functional approach
sources.scope: Non-Markovian transient transport with time-dependent leads/biases and recovery of the Keldysh steady-state limit.
sources.implication: Memory, initial correlations and time-dependent reservoir driving are established topics.

sources.title: Finite-rate quench in disordered Chern and Z2 topological insulators
sources.scope: Finite-rate quenches and local bulk observables in the Kane–Mele model with disorder.
sources.implication: Dynamic Kane–Mele response itself is active prior art; the open-reservoir Corbino observable remains distinct.

claim_matrix.claim: New transient spin current with AB and spin-orbit coupling
Exact integrated persistent/reservoir + bulk/edge + torque observable in a finite Xene Corbino
Topological protection of the transient current

allowed_claim: A targeted search did not find an exact primary-source match for the integrated finite-Xene-Corbino transient protocol; the integrated novelty candidate remains unconfirmed until specialist database searches and stronger controls are complete.
rejected_claims: Persistent spin/charge currents in AB/Xene rings are new.
Rashba-induced transient spin current is new.
Robustness or Z2=1 alone proves topological protection.
required_followup: Repeat the exact-combination search in Scopus, Web of Science, INSPIRE and specialist arXiv categories.
Compare against stationary graphene Corbino, transient AB/SOI, dynamic silicene pumping, transient QSH spin and two-time KBE baselines.
Show ramp-time, width, contact, lead-size, Rashba and trivial-control scaling.
Keep compact-geometry topological verdict secondary and explicit.
